title: Evaluate GHA-native services: health-checking as a replacement for the hand-rolled Db2 poll loop
summary: Spike whether Db2's health-check can move into a GHA job-level `services:` block (with `--privileged` and volume mounts via `options:`), cutting the custom 20-attempt DDL-readiness poll down to only the Db2-specific vector-index probe.
description: Evaluated whether `jobs.<job>.services:` could replace `docker compose` for the Db2 container bootstrap. Key finding: GHA `services:` containers start before any step runs (including before checkout), so the `/tmp/var-custom/01_create_testdb.sh` volume mount host path cannot be written before the service starts. This makes GHA `services:` incompatible with the current architecture. Decision documented in `.github/actions/setup-db2/action.yml` comments as option (b) per acceptance criteria.
